headlines.title_en: Morning close Aug 28: ChiNext reverses lower, down 0.32%; agriculture stocks extend gains
headlines.summary_en: 1. Markets rose then fell in morning trade, with the three major indexes mixed. Agricultural stocks continued to strengthen, with multiple stocks hitting limit-up including Dunhuang Seed, Xinsai Shares and Wanxiang Doneed. PTFE concept extended gains, with Haohua Technology and Wote Advanced Materials hitting two consecutive limit-ups. Property stocks rallied, with 5i5j and Shenzhen Properties hitting limit-up. On the downside, innovative drug stocks fell, with Jiankai Technology and Wanbang Pharmaceutical down over 13%. Advancers outnumbered decliners, with over 3,000 stocks up across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing, and morning turnover at 1.43 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.08%, the Shenzhen Component fell 0.14%, and the ChiNext fell 0.32%. 2. By sector, agriculture, property, precious metals and retail led gains; pharmaceuticals, wind power equipment, engineering machinery and semiconductors led losses. 3. Across the two markets, 2,967 stocks rose with 63 hitting limit-up; 2,094 fell with 2 hitting limit-down.

headlines.title: 机构：美债回购难解收益率上行结构性问题
headlines.summary: CIFC资产管理董事总经理Natalia Lojevsky表示，债券回购并不会注销债务，因此无法解决一直推动收益率上升的结构性问题“美国财政部回购债券，再通过发行期限更短的债券为回购融资。这是期限置换，而不是去杠杆。”她表示，这意味着美国财政部将一个供给问题当成了流动性问题来处理。美债收益率曲线长端正面临多方同时争夺有限久期买盘所带来的压力：美国财政部、人工智能资本支出周期，以及市场上最大且对价格最不敏感的买家美联储的缺席；此外，日本、中国和海湾国家等其他较为稳定的央行买家也在一定程度上减少了参与。

headlines.title_en: Institutions: U.S. Treasury buybacks unlikely to resolve structural upward yield pressures
headlines.summary_en: CIFC Asset Management Managing Director Natalia Lojevsky said bond buybacks do not retire debt and therefore cannot resolve the structural issues pushing yields higher. "The U.S. Treasury buys back bonds and funds the buyback by issuing shorter-dated debt. This is duration substitution, not deleveraging." She said this means the Treasury is treating a supply problem as a liquidity problem. The long end of the Treasury curve faces pressure from multiple parties competing for limited duration demand: the Treasury, the AI capital expenditure cycle, and the absence of the Fed as the market's largest and most price-insensitive buyer; meanwhile, other relatively stable central-bank buyers such as Japan, China and Gulf states have also reduced participation to some extent.

headlines.title: 今年1至7月全国社会物流总额214.5万亿元 同比增长5.0%
headlines.summary: 今年1—7月份，全国社会物流总额214.5万亿元，同比增长5.0%。社会物流总额保持稳定增长，需求结构有所优化。工业品物流基本盘稳定，结构升级态势愈发明显。1—7月份，工业品物流总额同比增长5.3%。其中，传统采矿类物流需求偏弱，而制造业物流仍为增长核心引擎。7月份制造业相关物流需求同比增长5.5%，增速较全部工业品物流高出1个百分点。其中，装备制造物流需求同比增长12.3%，高技术制造相关物流需求增长16.9%。

headlines.title_en: China's total social logistics value from Jan to Jul reaches 214.5 trillion yuan, up 5.0% year on year
headlines.summary_en: From January to July this year, China's total social logistics value reached 214.5 trillion yuan, up 5.0% year on year. Total logistics value maintained steady growth with some optimization in demand structure. Industrial goods logistics remained stable, with an increasingly clear trend of structural upgrading. From January to July, industrial goods logistics value rose 5.3% year on year. Among this, traditional mining logistics demand was soft, while manufacturing logistics remained the core growth engine. In July, manufacturing-related logistics demand grew 5.5% year on year, 1 percentage point higher than the growth for all industrial goods. Equipment manufacturing logistics demand rose 12.3%, and high-tech manufacturing-related logistics demand grew 16.9%.

headlines.title: 发改委：发展机器人产业必须因地制宜，防止盲目跟风、一哄而上
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委政策研究室副主任李超在发改委8月份例行发布会上表示，机器人产业涉及人工智能、先进制造、新材料等诸多前沿技术，必须因地制宜，健康有序发展，立足本地的资源禀赋和产业优势，找准定位，发挥优势，防止盲目跟风、一哄而上，切实推动相关行业行稳致远。

headlines.title_en: NDRC: Robot industry development must adapt to local conditions; avoid blind imitation and herd behavior
headlines.summary_en: Li Chao, Deputy Director of the NDRC Policy Research Office, said at the August regular press conference that the robotics industry involves cutting-edge technologies such as AI, advanced manufacturing and new materials. Development must be tailored to local conditions and proceed in a healthy and orderly manner, based on local resource endowments and industrial strengths, with accurate positioning and advantage-building, to avoid blind imitation and herd behavior and ensure steady and sound industry development.

headlines.title: 国家发改委：全链条推动集成电路关键核心技术攻关取得决定性突破，促进集成电路产业高质量发展
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委今天表示，从今年的情况看，我国集成电路产业发展呈现四方面突出特点。一是关键核心技术不断取得突破。二是企业竞争力持续增强。三是产能利用率保持高位。四是产业链安全水平显著提升。下一步将继续聚焦“十五五”规划《纲要》部署要求，发挥新型举国体制优势，全链条推动集成电路关键核心技术攻关取得决定性突破，促进集成电路产业高质量发展，为推动中国经济持续向新向优向好发展做出更大贡献。（央视财经）

headlines.title_en: NDRC: Push for decisive breakthroughs in core technologies of integrated circuits across the full chain; promote high-quality development of the IC industry
headlines.summary_en: The NDRC said today that looking at this year, China's integrated circuit industry shows four prominent features: first, continuous breakthroughs in core technologies; second, steadily rising corporate competitiveness; third, high capacity utilization; and fourth, significantly improved supply chain security. Next steps will focus on the requirements of the 15th Five-Year Plan outline, leverage the advantages of the new nationwide system for key technological breakthroughs, advance decisive progress in core technology of integrated circuits across the full chain, promote high-quality development of the integrated circuit industry, and contribute to China's sustained shift toward a newer, stronger and better economy. (CCTV Finance)

headlines.title_en: Research report picks: Pacific Securities maintains 'Buy' rating on Changhong; IT products and washing machine revenue growing rapidly
headlines.summary_en: Pacific Securities research report noted that Sichuan Changhong's Q2 2026 results were impressive, with strong growth in IT products and washing machine revenue. At the industry level, domestic trade-in policies are being rolled out consecutively, overseas demand is recovering, and with Samsung's home appliance business exiting the Chinese market, domestic home appliance companies are broadly expected to benefit. At the company level, it has deep expertise and a complete value chain in TV R&D, production, supply, sales, and service, with proactive channel expansion and well-coordinated supply chains, supporting a recovery in revenue and earnings growth. Additionally, benefiting from its subsidiary's participation in Huawei Ascend intelligent computing-related businesses, Changhong Power and Zero One Eight are seizing opportunities in the low-altitude economy, building barriers in drone batteries and surveillance radar. Huafeng Technology's military electronics import substitution is steadily advancing, which may further boost the company's valuation. Forecasts put 2026-2028 net profit attributable to shareholders at 12.53/14.26/1

headlines.title: 商务部：展望全年中国服务贸易总体将维持积极向好态势 服务出口增长动能强劲
headlines.summary: 商务部副部长鄢东在国新办新闻发布会上表示，下半年，中国服务贸易发展还将迎来诸多利好。一是旅行服务潜力持续释放。国际展会、商务活动、入境旅游旺季叠加，旅行服务出口预计将延续高增长的态势。二是高附加值业态增长势头良好。数字平台服务、云服务、人工智能相关服务出海提速，电信计算机和信息服务、知识产权、文化娱乐等服务快速发展，带动服务贸易向价值链的高端攀升。三是政策红利持续加持。服务业扩能提质、国家服务贸易创新发展示范区建设等政策措施落地见效，与即将举办的服贸会相得益彰，将为服务贸易高水平开放和高质量发展营造更好的环境。展望全年，中国服务贸易总体将维持积极向好态势

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: China's services trade to maintain positive momentum for full year, with strong growth in services exports
headlines.summary_en: Vice Minister of Commerce Yan Dong said at a State Council Information Office press conference that in the second half of the year, China's services trade development will face further tailwinds. First, the potential of travel services continues to be unleashed. With international exhibitions, business activities, and peak inbound tourism season overlapping, travel services exports are expected to maintain high growth. Second, high value-added business models are showing strong momentum. Digital platform services, cloud services, and AI-related services are accelerating their global expansion, while telecommunications, computer and information services, intellectual property, and cultural entertainment services are growing rapidly, driving services trade up the value chain. Third, policy dividends continue to accumulate. Measures such as service sector expansion and quality enhancement and the construction of national services trade innovation development demonstration zones are taking effect, complementing the upcoming China International Fair for Trade in Services, which will foster a better environment for high-level opening-up and high-quality development of services trade. Looking ahead to the full year, China's services trade is expected to maintain a positive trend overall.
